extension.description: Display locally installed Codex pets in the VS Code Panel.
view.name: PET
config.enabled: Enable the Pet Viewer for Codex view.
config.petDirectory: Override the Pet directory. Leave empty to use CODEX_HOME/pets. Reload the window after changing it.
config.scale: Pet image size multiplier. The image still shrinks responsively when the PET view is smaller.
config.background: Background shown behind the Pet. You can also change it from the webview context menu.
config.pauseWhenHidden: Pause animation while the Pet webview is hidden.
config.watchPetDirectory: Reload Pets automatically when files change.
config.integrationMode: Choose manual commands, the managed App Server, or Codex Hooks integration.
config.appServerExecutable: Codex CLI executable used for the managed App Server.
config.appServerAutoStart: Start the managed App Server automatically when integrationMode is appServer.
integration.appServer: Use the App Server managed by this extension.
integration.hooks: Reflect sessions from Codex Hooks, including the official Codex extension.
